Then there was Danny, leading Ballers South: Team Mexico 🇲🇽, the wild cards. Nobody—not even Danny—knew exactly what list he was bringing until he unzipped the army case. He'd casually say, "Trust me, I've got a plan," in the same tone a guy might use before trying to fix a transmission with duct tape and optimism. The scary part? It usually worked. Every tournament had at least one opponent walking away muttering, "I have absolutely no idea what just happened."
